Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation (ICLR 2024 paper) match the expected results in the plan file. Key metrics include: (1) GPT-J+FV shuffled-label accuracy 90.8% matches documentation Table 2; (2) GPT-J+FV zero-shot accuracy 57.5% matches documentation; (3) 34 additional tasks performance 80.4%/46.1% matches documentation; (4) Country-Capital vocab reconstruction 58.1% vs 83.2% matches Table 6; (5) Vector algebra composition results (Last-Country-Capital 0.60 vs 0.32 ICL) match Table 7; (6) Natural text Antonym FV performance 55-68% matches Table 3. No contradictions found between plan and documented results.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All plan steps have corresponding implementations in the codebase: (1) Causal mediation analysis implemented in compute_indirect_effect.py and extract_utils.py (AIE calculation and FV extraction); (2) Testing across models/tasks implemented in evaluate_function_vector.py with model_utils.py supporting GPT-J, GPT-NeoX, and Llama models; (3) FV vocab analysis implemented in vocab_reconstruction.py with optim_loop() for matching top-k tokens; (4) Vector algebra composition supported by intervention_utils.py function_vector_intervention(); (5) Template portability implemented in portability_eval.py; (6) Natural text evaluation implemented in natural_text_eval.py with 5 sentence templates. All 4 methodology steps and 6 planned experiments have matching implementation files.
